title: [CON2-4] The TURN shared secret is IO key material that ARCHITECTURE S3 and S7 do not allow
description: Review finding CON2-4: The TURN shared secret is IO key material that ARCHITECTURE S3 and S7 do not allow (lens CON2). Location: ARCHITECTURE.md:97-101, :119-123; spec/06-calls.md:281. Fix: S3: "The only key material an IO holds for a community is the verification material of §6.2: registered admission public keys and the routing tokens registered with them." S7 lists TURN explicitly. 06 §6.11 step 1 gives the TURN operator a CO-shared HMAC secret. Design is sound (no member identity exposed); the invariant text is wrong. Extend ARCHITECTURE S3 and S7 to name "the TURN REST shared secret of a `turn` agreement (protocol spec §6.11), which authenticates the CO credential service and identifies no member", and add it to §6 beside admission keys. Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
